description: Analyse a connected Ramp account's wire and international bill volume to surface DPX settlement opportunity. Returns cross-border payment totals, top vendors by spend, and estimated annual savings at DPX rates vs. typical bank wire. Requires a Ramp account connected via ramp.connect.

page_size.description: Number of bills to analyse (default 100, max 500).

tenant_id.description: Tenant ID of the connected Ramp account.

name: ramp.spend_analysis
